summary: Add an opt-in shared readiness case with phase-specific owner and held informational notices.

replay.detail: A separate readiness-case journal replays pending legacy cuts through the legacy writer before fresh readings. Fresh drain cuts must strictly advance its durable cursor; exact pending work replays separately. Recovery atomically advances the short-admission cursor through the recovered weekly cut, preserving that boundary across restart. Existing weekly episodes drain under their existing writer without a shared-case primary notice; new shared phases and notice intents replay from native receipts.

rules.detail: Enabled shared cases replace independent weekly dispatch. Each escalation phase sends one actionable notice to the original owner and optionally one held informational notice to a distinct backup. Undelivered informational intents are bounded per phase and discarded on recovery. Measured recovery closes failure receipts without a new owner notice; Unknown preserves unresolved cases.

compatibility.detail: Shared routing defaults off. Legacy weekly configuration remains accepted and its checkpoint bytes are unchanged. Retained evidence display and shared routing are separate opt-ins.

manual.detail: To enable shared routing, configure retained_pairs_file and shared_case on the selected executor. An optional backup selects a held informational recipient; the deployment supplies its compiled binding.

recovery.detail: Retain both the legacy weekly checkpoint and separate readiness-case journal across restart. Upgrade fault readers before enabling shared routing.
